english:
Let $\overrightarrow{a}_0$, $\overrightarrow{b}_0$, $\overrightarrow{c}_0$ be three non-coplanar vectors. For every integer $n\ge 0$, define $\overrightarrow{a}_{n+1}=\dfrac{\overrightarrow{b}_n+\overrightarrow{c}_n}{2}$, $\overrightarrow{b}_{n+1}=\dfrac{\overrightarrow{c}_n+\overrightarrow{a}_n}{2}$ and $\overrightarrow{c}_{n+1}=\dfrac{\overrightarrow{a}_n+\overrightarrow{b}_n}{2}$. If $\overrightarrow{c}_3=\lambda\overrightarrow{a}_0+\mu\overrightarrow{b}_0+
u\overrightarrow{c}_0$, where $\lambda$, $\mu$, $
u$ are real numbers, then the value of $
u$ is ______.
hindi:
माना $\overrightarrow{a}_0$, $\overrightarrow{b}_0$, $\overrightarrow{c}_0$ तीन असमतलीय सदिश हैं। प्रत्येक पूर्णांक $n\ge 0$ के लिए $\overrightarrow{a}_{n+1}=\dfrac{\overrightarrow{b}_n+\overrightarrow{c}_n}{2}$, $\overrightarrow{b}_{n+1}=\dfrac{\overrightarrow{c}_n+\overrightarrow{a}_n}{2}$ तथा $\overrightarrow{c}_{n+1}=\dfrac{\overrightarrow{a}_n+\overrightarrow{b}_n}{2}$ परिभाषित कीजिए। यदि $\overrightarrow{c}_3=\lambda\overrightarrow{a}_0+\mu\overrightarrow{b}_0+
u\overrightarrow{c}_0$ है, जहाँ $\lambda$, $\mu$, $
u$ वास्तविक संख्याएँ हैं, तो $
u$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Adding the three relations: $\overrightarrow{S}=\overrightarrow{a}_n+\overrightarrow{b}_n+\overrightarrow{c}_n$ is the same for every $n$
$\overrightarrow{a}_0,\overrightarrow{b}_0,\overrightarrow{c}_0$ non-coplanar, so the coefficients are unique: $\nu=\dfrac14=0.25$
solution_full: Adding the three defining relations gives $\overrightarrow{a}_{n+1}+\overrightarrow{b}_{n+1}+\overrightarrow{c}_{n+1}=\overrightarrow{a}_n+\overrightarrow{b}_n+\overrightarrow{c}_n$, so $\overrightarrow{S}=\overrightarrow{a}_0+\overrightarrow{b}_0+\overrightarrow{c}_0$ equals $\overrightarrow{a}_n+\overrightarrow{b}_n+\overrightarrow{c}_n$ for every $n$.

Because $\overrightarrow{a}_0,\overrightarrow{b}_0,\overrightarrow{c}_0$ are non-coplanar, every vector has a unique expression as their linear combination, so $\lambda=\mu=\dfrac38$ and $\nu=\dfrac14$.
originality_note: New: a simultaneous averaging map on three vectors iterated three times; the invariant sum S and the factor -1/2 on c_n - S/3 make the coefficients clean (way 1, iteration with an invariant). Closest known: 'express a vector in terms of three non-coplanar vectors' and the medial-triangle iteration for points. Different because: the recursion acts on free vectors and the coefficient of c_0 must be tracked through the invariant or three rounds of averaging.

concept_use.Algebraic operations on a vector: Vector addition and scalar multiplication give the invariant sum S and the relation c_{n+1} - S/3 = -(c_n - S/3)/2; unique coefficients because a_0, b_0, c_0 are non-coplanar.
